test_gtn_equal: test gtn.equal to check if two graphs have identical nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test gtn.isomorphic to check if two graphs have the same structure regardless of node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test gtn.loadtxt to load a graph from a text file and verify it matches the expected graph
test_gtn_savetxt: test gtn.savetxt to save a graph to a text file and verify the output format
test_gtn_save_load: test gtn.save and gtn.load to serialize and deserialize graphs to binary format
